machines.purpose: Intake filtration: dual HEPA banks over charcoal beds keeping the shelter breathable
machines.age_origin: Documented as the central blower and filter station, specified for a three-hand crew; the crew's own second blower was jury-wired into the intake leg
machines.baseline_sound: A steady low draw, day and night; the intake stool tastes it first

machines.purpose: Grey-iron casting for everything the shelter repairs
machines.age_origin: Documented as the refractory cupola and casting bay, rated five hundred kilos per heat
machines.baseline_sound: A slow settling tick between heats; pouring is loud work done deliberately quietly
machines.memorial_hook: Builder's plate on the cupola (room_fixture_foundry_works_plate) - reserved memorial hook (29B.20)

machines.purpose: Main generation and DC reserve for the whole electrical bus
machines.age_origin: Documented as the diesel generator and alternator vault with the battery and inverter vault beside it
machines.baseline_sound: A diesel idle carried through the slab, and the relay that settles after it starts

machines.condition_owner: VentilationSystem (exhaustFilterSaturation / ductIntegrity / duct and valve state)
machines.purpose: Exhaust legs and dampers for the foundry, generator and galley; recirculation when the stack is unsafe
machines.age_origin: Ducted from the pre-war blower station; the legs were re-pointed when the exhaust shaft was blocked
machines.baseline_sound: A slow stack draft and the dampers holding their line

machines.purpose: Charcoal, distillation and reverse osmosis for everything the shelter drinks
machines.age_origin: Documented as the brine still and reverse-osmosis unit in the engineering record
machines.baseline_sound: A slow flow and a steady gauge needle

machines.purpose: Radiator loop and hot water for the residential level
machines.age_origin: Converted from the canteen range when the deep heating manifold was isolated
machines.baseline_sound: A steady low fire with a two-beat jacket tick

machines.purpose: Interlock, wheel winch and the sentry call at the hatch
machines.age_origin: Documented behind a three-ton lead-faced door running on a counterweight winch; the winch sling has replaced the original cable
machines.baseline_sound: A heavy latch and a long equalising hiss

quirks.text_cue: The intake whistles on the draw — the filters are loaded.
quirks.maintenance_action: Service (ServiceAirFilter) or replace the HEPA cartridge (ReplaceAirFilter). The owner raises its air-hazard warning at exactly this floor.

quirks.text_cue: The intake coughs dust after the storm — the filters are eating ashfall.
quirks.maintenance_action: Service or replace the cartridge; hazard weather doubles the clog rate in the owner.

quirks.text_cue: The housings tick as they cool after the evening watch. Always twice.
The tuyeres knock in threes before a pour — hearth brick is going.
quirks.maintenance_action: Rebuild the hearth tuyeres (StartRepair(HearthTuyeres), firebrick). The owner warns of breakout risk below 35.

quirks.text_cue: The stack whines on the up-draft. The exhaust is losing pull.
quirks.maintenance_action: Repair the safety exhaust (StartRepair(SafetyExhaust)). The owner warns fumes concentrate below 30.

quirks.text_cue: The generator coughs twice before it catches — the tank is under a day.
quirks.maintenance_action: Add fuel (PowerGridSystem.AddFuel); partial generation halves the bus when the tank runs dry.

quirks.text_cue: The lights dip when heavy plant starts. The reserve is thin.
quirks.maintenance_action: Rebalance load and priorities or add fuel (PowerGridSystem). Brownout trips follow a thin reserve.

quirks.text_cue: The exhaust leg rattles as the differential builds — the media is loaded.
quirks.maintenance_action: Service or replace the exhaust filter (VentilationSystem.ServiceFilter / ReplaceFilter); the owner logs smoke hazard above 60.

quirks.text_cue: The still runs long and draws slow — the membranes are nearly spent.
quirks.maintenance_action: Replace the water filter (WaterTreatmentSystem.ReplaceFilter); the owner blocks reverse osmosis when integrity cannot cover the draw.

quirks.text_cue: The boiler sputters near the bottom of its tank — it will cut out soon.
quirks.maintenance_action: Fuel and restart the boiler (SetBoilerActive); the owner shuts it down dry at zero.

quirks.text_cue: The door drags on its seal mid-cycle — the owner has a pending incident.
quirks.maintenance_action: Resolve the pending incident through the owner and fit a new gasket.

quirks.text_cue: The jacket ticks as the fire settles. It has done that since it was a range.
The intake hum changes pitch when the radon spikes — the stack is pulling harder against a heavier mix.
quirks.maintenance_action: Increase filter duty cycles (StartingLevelSystem); the owner warns at this radon floor.

quirks.text_cue: The air above the cupola shimmers even when the furnace is cold. It is the residual heat leaving the lining, and it takes longer than it should.
The floor vibration has a pitch. It is lower when the tuyeres are good and rises when the brick goes. The crew feel it before they hear it.
The panel flickers on the brownout leg. The generator is running but the bus is not clean.
quirks.maintenance_action: Balance load and re-seat breakers (PowerGridSystem); the owner logs brownout below this reserve.

quirks.text_cue: The generator ticks on its mount at idle — a metronome that nobody tuned because it has always been there.
The ventilation leg carries a soot smell before the gauge moves. The filter is loading and the exhaust is not clearing.
quirks.maintenance_action: Service or replace the exhaust filter and clear the duct (VentilationSystem).

quirks.text_cue: The still hums at a frequency that is not in the catalogue. It changes with the water chemistry and the crew have stopped noticing it.
The airlock machinery grinds once on the up-stroke and seats clean. It is the seal bedding in, and it has done it every day since the hatch was last opened.

glitch_events.title: The Draft That Isn't
glitch_events.presentation: A cold thread of air along the north corridor, ankle height, and every damper shut. Nobody has ever found the gap.

glitch_events.title: The Relay That Counts Twice
glitch_events.presentation: The main relay clicks twice at odd hours. The bus reads clean. Somebody counted, once, and wrote NOT LOAD on the panel in pencil.

glitch_events.title: The Old Intercom Speaks
glitch_events.presentation: A half-second carrier burst on the dead intercom — static and a room tone from somewhere with wind in it.

glitch_events.title: The Seal Cycles Itself
glitch_events.presentation: The inner seal runs half a stroke and seats again, unasked. The sentry's board shows a pending incident.
glitch_events.resolution: Resolve the incident through the owner (AirlockSecuritySystem) and fit a new gasket.

glitch_events.title: The Ground Loop, Again
glitch_events.presentation: Bulbs burn orange at the filament and the tubes flicker at the edge of seeing. The neutral is drifting again.
glitch_events.resolution: Re-seat the breaker bus and balance load (PowerGridSystem breakers/priorities); the owner logs brownout risk.

glitch_events.title: Damper Off Its Seat
glitch_events.presentation: The foundry leg's damper is not seating. Smoke pools on the charging floor before it reaches the stack.
glitch_events.resolution: Service or replace the exhaust filter and clear the duct (VentilationSystem.ServiceFilter / ReplaceFilter / ClearDuct).

glitch_events.title: Flutter At The Still
glitch_events.presentation: The gauge flutters and the flow stutters. The membranes are spending themselves faster than anyone books.
glitch_events.resolution: Replace the water filter (WaterTreatmentSystem.ReplaceFilter); the owner blocks reverse osmosis when integrity cannot cover the draw.

glitch_events.title: The Boiler Cuts Out
glitch_events.presentation: The boiler lights, runs short, cuts out. The tank is nearly dry and the radiators know it first.
glitch_events.resolution: Fuel and restart the boiler (ShelterThermalSystem.SetBoilerActive); watch the frost lines.

glitch_events.title: The Boiler Sighs
glitch_events.presentation: The boiler sighs once through the jacket — a long exhalation of steam that is not on the cycle. It does not repeat.

glitch_events.title: The Hum Drops
glitch_events.presentation: The generator hum drops half an octave for three seconds and recovers. The frequency meter shows nothing. The crew look up anyway.

glitch_events.title: The Still Gurgles
glitch_events.presentation: The water still gurgles once through the trap — a single bubble that does not belong to any cycle. The gauge is steady.
